title: Managed harness
hook: Define model + system prompt + tools; AgentCore runs the whole agent loop. Zero orchestration code.

back.lead: The managed harness lets you stand up a working agent by declaring a model, a system prompt, and tools — no loop code. The harness manages reasoning, tool selection, action execution, and response streaming, with each session in its own microVM with filesystem and shell access.

kv.v: Switch models mid-session; any create-time configuration can be overridden per invocation, so you experiment without redeploying.
Runtime hosts your loop; the harness is the loop. Choose based on how much control your architecture needs.
Fast prototyping, straightforward tool-use agents, and per-request experimentation.

back.hookline: Prompt-and-tools declarative agents — bring code only when your loop logic genuinely needs it.
